newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia Motors May vehicle sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Kia Motors May vehicle sales rise.

text.p: Kia Motors Corp said on Monday it sold a total of 70,413 vehicles in May, including exports, against 69,505 units a year earlier.
Kia's exports in the month rose to 40,080 units from 29,048 a year before, while domestic sales fell to 30,333 units from 40,457 units, the company said.
A Kia spokesman said exports were backed by the company's efforts to strengthen sales networks in overseas markets, including the U.S. and Germany.
"But domestic sales were affected by Daewoo's introduction of new model cars," he said.
Daewoo has introduced three new models -- Lanos sub-compact cars, Nubira compact and Leganza medium-sized sedans since last November.
